select greatest( 0, ( select count(1) from tracklet t where t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' ) - ( select count(1) from tracklet t where t.gallery_target_id is not null and t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' ) )

select t.id::text as id, to_char(t.start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as start_time from tracklet t where t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' and t.stranger_target_id is not null order by t.start_ts desc limit 1

select count(1) from llm_report

select a.id, a.alarm_level, a.event_type_key, a.camera_id, a.thumbnail, a.record_url, a.stream_id, a.asset_start_ts, a.duration_ms, a."timestamp", a.alarm_ts from ( select v.id::text as id, case when v.anomaly_name = 'fire' then 'error' when v.anomaly_name = 'fight' then 'warning' when v.anomaly_name = 'fall' then 'warning' else 'info' end as alarm_level, v.anomaly_name as event_type_key, coalesce(c.camera_code, substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) as camera_id, case when v.frame_vad_base64 is null then ma.play_url else ('data:image/jpeg;base64:' || v.frame_vad_base64) end as thumbnail, ma.play_url as record_url, case when substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') is not null then ('live/' || substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) else null end as stream_id, ma.start_ts as asset_start_ts, ma.duration_ms as duration_ms, to_char(v.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "timestamp", v.created_at as alarm_ts, v.created_at as sort_ts from vad v left join media_asset ma on ma.id = v.media_asset_id left join camera_stream cs on cs.stream_name = substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') left join camera c on c.id = cs.camera_id where v.anomaly_name in ('fight', 'fire', 'fall') ) a order by a.sort_ts desc limit 5

select a.id, a.alarm_level, a.event_type_key, a.camera_id, a.thumbnail, a.record_url, a.stream_id, a.asset_start_ts, a.duration_ms, a."timestamp", a.alarm_ts from ( select v.id::text as id, case when v.anomaly_name = 'fire' then 'error' when v.anomaly_name = 'fight' then 'warning' when v.anomaly_name = 'fall' then 'warning' else 'info' end as alarm_level, v.anomaly_name as event_type_key, coalesce(c.camera_code, substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) as camera_id, case when v.frame_vad_base64 is null then ma.play_url else ('data:image/jpeg;base64:' || v.frame_vad_base64) end as thumbnail, ma.play_url as record_url, case when substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') is not null then ('live/' || substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) else null end as stream_id, ma.start_ts as asset_start_ts, ma.duration_ms as duration_ms, to_char(v.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "timestamp", v.created_at as alarm_ts, v.created_at as sort_ts from vad v left join media_asset ma on ma.id = v.media_asset_id left join camera_stream cs on cs.stream_name = substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') left join camera c on c.id = cs.camera_id where v.anomaly_name in ('fight', 'fire', 'fall') ) a order by a.sort_ts desc limit 1

select count(1) from tracklet t where t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' and (t.gallery_target_id is not null or t.stranger_target_id is not null)

select t.id::text as id, to_char(t.start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as start_time from tracklet t where t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' and (t.gallery_target_id is not null or t.stranger_target_id is not null) order by t.start_ts desc limit 1

select to_char( date_trunc('hour', t.start_ts) + (floor(extract(minute from t.start_ts) / 10) * interval '10 minutes'), 'HH24:MI' ) as time, count(1) as count from tracklet t where t.start_ts >= #{startTs} and t.start_ts < #{endTs} and (t.gallery_target_id is not null or t.stranger_target_id is not null) group by 1

select t.id::text as id, rt.id::text as target_id, rt.name as name, case when rt.image_base64 is not null then ('data:image/jpeg;base64:' || rt.image_base64) else null end as avatar, null as age, null as gender, '学生' as identity_type, c.camera_code as camera_id, to_char(t.start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as detected_time, t.start_ts as sort_ts from tracklet t left join camera_stream cs on cs.stream_name = t.stream_id left join camera c on c.id = cs.camera_id left join reid_target rt on rt.id = t.gallery_target_id where t.gallery_target_id is not null and t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' order by t.start_ts desc limit 20

select t.id::text as id, rt.id::text as target_id, rt.name as name, case when rt.image_base64 is not null then ('data:image/jpeg;base64:' || rt.image_base64) else null end as avatar, null as age, null as gender, '学生' as identity_type, c.camera_code as camera_id, to_char(t.start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as detected_time, t.start_ts as sort_ts from tracklet t left join camera_stream cs on cs.stream_name = t.stream_id left join camera c on c.id = cs.camera_id left join reid_target rt on rt.id = t.gallery_target_id where t.gallery_target_id is not null and t.start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and t.start_ts < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' order by t.start_ts desc limit 1

select r.id::text as id, r.episode_id::text as episode_id, r.vad_id as vad_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(r.prompt_type), ''), case when r.vad_id is not null then 'vad' when r.episode_id is not null then 'reid' else null end) as prompt_type, r.report_json::text as report_json, r.report_text as report_text, r.created_at as created_at, e.meta::text as episode_meta, tr.frame_end_base64 as reid_frame_end_base64, v.frame_vad_base64 as frame_vad_base64, coalesce( case when tr.stream_id is null then null when position('live/' in tr.stream_id) = 1 then tr.stream_id else ('live/' || tr.stream_id) end, case when substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') is not null then ('live/' || substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) else null end ) as stream_id, ma.start_ts as asset_start_ts, ma.duration_ms as duration_ms, ma.play_url as record_url, coalesce(v.created_at, tr.start_ts, r.created_at) as alarm_ts, r.created_at as sort_ts from llm_report r left join episode e on e.id = r.episode_id left join vad v on v.id = r.vad_id left join media_asset ma on ma.id = v.media_asset_id left join lateral ( select t.stream_id as stream_id, t.start_ts as start_ts, t.end_ts as end_ts, t.frame_end_base64 as frame_end_base64 from episode_tracklet_link l join tracklet t on t.id = l.tracklet_id where l.episode_id = r.episode_id order by t.end_ts desc nulls last, t.start_ts desc limit 1 ) tr on true where r.created_at >= now() - (#{lookbackSeconds} * interval '1 second') order by r.created_at desc, r.id desc limit #{limit}

select r.id::text as id, r.episode_id::text as episode_id, r.vad_id as vad_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(r.prompt_type), ''), case when r.vad_id is not null then 'vad' when r.episode_id is not null then 'reid' else null end) as prompt_type, r.report_json::text as report_json, r.report_text as report_text, r.created_at as created_at, e.meta::text as episode_meta, tr.frame_end_base64 as reid_frame_end_base64, v.frame_vad_base64 as frame_vad_base64, coalesce( case when tr.stream_id is null then null when position('live/' in tr.stream_id) = 1 then tr.stream_id else ('live/' || tr.stream_id) end, case when substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)') is not null then ('live/' || substring(trim(v.stream_id) from '(camera_[0-9]+)')) else null end ) as stream_id, ma.start_ts as asset_start_ts, ma.duration_ms as duration_ms, ma.play_url as record_url, coalesce(v.created_at, tr.start_ts, r.created_at) as alarm_ts, r.created_at as sort_ts from llm_report r left join episode e on e.id = r.episode_id left join vad v on v.id = r.vad_id left join media_asset ma on ma.id = v.media_asset_id left join lateral ( select t.stream_id as stream_id, t.start_ts as start_ts, t.end_ts as end_ts, t.frame_end_base64 as frame_end_base64 from episode_tracklet_link l join tracklet t on t.id = l.tracklet_id where l.episode_id = r.episode_id order by t.end_ts desc nulls last, t.start_ts desc limit 1 ) tr on true where r.created_at > #{createdAt} or (r.created_at = #{createdAt} and r.id > #{id}::uuid) order by r.created_at asc, r.id asc limit #{limit}
